label: Battery Low SOC Alarm
info:
Battery Low SOC Alarm - Polls every 5 minutes

Registers:
- 217: lowBatteryCapacityPercent (threshold)
- 688: socPercent (current battery SOC)

Logic:
- If socPercent < threshold: Check step (5% increments)
- Only send if step decreased from last sent
- Reset when socPercent >= threshold

name: Prep Parallel Reads
Collect Reads
Check & Build Alarm
Check if should send
Reset Context
